BRIEF FACTS :- Case of the prosecution is that the marriage of CW.1/ complainant was held with deceased Bettegowda who is son of accused no.1 and 2 and brother of accused no.3 and after the marriage, husband of complainant has been died, there after accused no.1 to 3 subjected to bring dowry given physical and mental harassment to the CW.1 and also they wrongfully restrained and abused in filthy language and treat to be caused death of CW.1 and also the site which was purchased out of the amount of complainant parents has been sold by the accused to the CW.8 by suppressing the CW.1 presence and charted the complainant with dishonest intention.
C.C.No.17129/2023 3.

Based on the information of CW-1, the police have registered the case, investigation was conducted and after completion of the investigation, charge sheet filed against the accused no.1 to 3 stating that they have as committed the aforesaid offences.
4. The accused no.1 to 3 have entered appearance in response to the summons and has been enlarged on bail.
The prosecution papers has been supplied to the accused no.1 to 3.
After hearing the charge is read over and explained to the accused no.1 to 3 to which they pleaded not guilty and claimes to be tried.
5. The prosecution has examined C.W.1/P.W.1 and Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.5 documents are exhibited.
6. The statement under Sec.313 of Cr.P.C., was dispensed.
Because there is no incriminating evidence against accused.
7. Heard the arguments.
Perused the documents on record.

The following points that arise for my consideration:-
1. Whether the prosecution proves beyond reasonable doubt the marriage of CW.1/Complainant was held with deceased Bettegowda who is son of accused no.1 and 2 and brother of accused no.3 and after the marriage, husband of complainant has been died there after accused no. 1 to 3 subjected to bring dowry given physical and mental harassment to the CW.1 and thereby committed an offence punishable U/sec.498(A) of IPC ?

2. Whether the prosecution proves beyond reasonable doubt that on the above mentioned date, time and place the Accused have wrongfully restrained the CW.1 and thereby committed an offence punishable U/s.341 of IPC ?

3. Whether the prosecution proves beyond reasonable doubt that on the above mentioned date, time and place the accused have abused in filthy language C.C.No.17129/2023 and thereby committed an offence punishable U/s.504 of IPC ?

2 4. Whether the prosecution proves beyond reasonable doubt that on the above mentioned date, time and place the accused have treat to be caused death of CW.1 and thereby committed an offence punishable U/s.506 of IPC ?

5. Whether the prosecution proves beyond reasonable doubt that on the above mentioned date, time and place the accused have the site which was purchase out of the amount of complainant parents has been sold by the accused to the CW.8 by suppressing the CW.1 presence and cheated with dishonest intention and thereby committed an offence punishable U/s.420 of IPC ?
6. What order?
9.

For the reasons to be stated herein after, I answer the above points as follows:
C.C.No.17129/2023 Point No.1 to 5 - In the Negative Point No.6 - As per the final order for the following:-
REASONS 10. Point No.1 to 5:- These points are connected with each other, hence they have taken up together for common discussion to avoid brevity.
11. In the instant case PW.1 is the complainant who has testified that she does not know anything about this case.
That she has not given the complaint as per Ex.P.1 in this regard.
Although PW.1 subscribes to her signatures appearing in the complaint as per Ex.P.1 and spot mahazar at Ex.P.2.
Ex.P.3 Marriage invitation card, Ex.P.4 photos, Ex.5 statement of PW 1.
She pleads ignorance to the contents of Ex.P.1 and Ex.P.2.
PW.1 is turned hostile and cross-examined by the Ld.Sr.APP wherein nothing substantial is elicited in order to support the case of prosecution.
. During the course of arguments Ld.Sr.APP and accused counsel argued as per the evidence and prays to dispose the case.

13. Further admittedly this case arise out of the complaint given by the complainant and the Investigation Officer filed charge sheet for the alleged offences and after framing the charge due to settlement of dispute between the complainant and accused no.1 to 3, the complainant has turned hostile and in spite of cross-examination by the Ld.Sr.APP, PW.1 has not supported the prosecution case.
So in the absence of incriminating evidence the other evidence of charge sheet witnesses is taken has dropped by rejecting the prayer of Ld.Sr.APP.

Because on examination of other charge sheet witnesses, that too in the absence of incriminating evidence, in the evidence of PW.1 no purpose of prosecution case will survives, so in order to save the very precious time of this court and due to C.C.No.17129/2023 compromise of dispute between the parties, this court is the opinion that the evidence of other witnesses is not at all requires, accordingly

sentences.text: the evidence of remaining witnesses taken as nil and in the absence of incriminating evidence, the statement U/s.313 of Cr.P.C is dispensed with and then case is posted for arguments.

14. Further this court was of the opinion that PW.1 is the material witness who has compromised with the accused no.1 to 3 and therefore the remaining witnesses were dropped by rejecting the prayer of Ld.Sr.APP.
15. On considering the evidence of PW.1 the complaint at Ex.P.1, the evidence of PW.1 appears to be contradictory.
The evidence of PW.1 is inconsistent with Ex.P.1.
PW.1 admitted to have compromised with the accused no.1 to 3.
Therefore, I hold that the C.C.No.17129/2023 prosecution is unable to establish the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Hence, the accused no.1 to3 deserves to be acquitted.
Therefore, I answer points No.1 to 5 in the NEGATIVE.
16. Point No.1 to 5:

From the discussions on foregoing points, this court opined that prosecution has failed to establish the guilt of the accused no.1 to 3 punishable under the alleged sections 498A, 504,
506, 341, 120B, 420 of Indian Penal Code.

Therefore, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER Accused no.1 to 3 are not found guilty.

Acting U/s.248(1) Cr.P.C., I hereby ACQUIT the accused no.1 to 3 of the offences punishable U/sec. 498A, 504, 506, 341,
420 of IPC.
The bail bond of the accused no.1 to 3 stands cancelled.
The cash security offered by accused no.1 to 3 for their release on bail shall be refunded on proper identification, after appeal period is over.
